key_findings: Coinbase is a named XRP custodian for Bitwise, Franklin, Grayscale and 21Shares; Coinbase Inc. is also prime broker for Franklin and Grayscale.
Grayscale added Anchorage as an additional custodian on September 29, while retaining Coinbase as primary. The amount to be moved to Anchorage was not determined.
Grayscale enabled in-kind XRP creations/redemptions with Macquarie and Virtu from September 29. Actual in-kind usage and AP sourcing venues remain unknown.

The four funds with SEC-confirmed Coinbase custody/prime-broker relationships represent about 898.54M XRP (75.1% of tracker ETF holdings), but this is not Coinbase's custody balance; multi-custodian splits are undisclosed.
The XRP ETF tracker reports 1.1966B XRP and $1.503B AUM across seven products; October 26–30 net flow was +3.39M XRP, but October 30 alone was -49,932 XRP.
Coinbase is a central institutional XRP infrastructure node, but BitGo and Anchorage diversify custody. No exclusive control or exact custody market share is established.
